wire.remote_compute.alone: --remote-status and --remote-cancel are commands of their own: run one on its own, without --remote or other run options.
wire.remote_compute.bad_repo: Because this run clones the repository from the far end, --repo must be an https:// or ssh:// URL, or a git@host:path address; a local path cannot be used.
wire.remote_compute.bad_sha: The --sha value must be a full 40-character commit SHA: a branch name or an abbreviated hash could resolve to a different commit than the one this run was submitted for.
wire.remote_compute.conflict: That idempotency key was already used with a different request body. Pass a new one with --idempotency-key.
wire.remote_compute.disabled: Remote compute is off. Turn it on with `lop config edit remote_compute.enabled true`, then run this again.
wire.remote_compute.finished_expired: Remote run {run_id} finished: expired, so it reached its deadline before it was done.
wire.remote_compute.finished_unknown: Remote run {run_id} is no longer running, but Radient reported no outcome this build can read.
wire.remote_compute.interrupted: Stopped watching run {run_id}; it is still running remotely. Cancel it with: lop exec --remote-cancel {run_id}
wire.remote_compute.invalid_request: Radient rejected the request as invalid. That is a bug in this client, not something to retype.
wire.remote_compute.key_empty: An empty --idempotency-key is refused rather than replaced with a fresh key: leave the flag out to mint one, or pass the key of the run you are retrying.
wire.remote_compute.key_not_printable: The idempotency key must be printable ASCII: letters, digits and punctuation only, with no accents, tabs or newlines.
wire.remote_compute.key_too_long: The idempotency key is longer than {max_bytes} bytes, which the server refuses: pass a key of at most {max_bytes} bytes.
wire.remote_compute.local_only: {flag} only makes sense for a local run, so it cannot be combined with --remote.
wire.remote_compute.needs_prompt: --remote needs a prompt: pass the task as the one positional argument.
wire.remote_compute.needs_repo: --remote needs --repo <url> and --sha <commit>: this run never uploads local files, so name the repository and commit to check out.
wire.remote_compute.network_mismatch: Radient answered with a run from another network, or without a network id, so it cannot be reported as a run of this network.
wire.remote_compute.no_capacity: Radient has no remote-compute capacity right now; try again later.
wire.remote_compute.no_credit: Radient has no compute credit for this account, so the run was not admitted.
wire.remote_compute.retrying: Radient reported an error for this run and retries it, so this watch continues.
wire.remote_compute.status_network_match: network checked: this run is in {network_id}, this device's network.
wire.remote_compute.status_network_misma: network checked: this run is in {network_id}, which is not this device's network.
wire.remote_compute.status_network_uncon: network unconfirmed: this device cannot tell which network this run belongs to.
wire.remote_compute.status_unknown: status: {status} (not a status this build knows; still watching)
wire.remote_compute.still_running: Run {run_id} is still running past the {max_hours}-hour limit Radient reported for it, so this command stopped watching. Check it with: lop exec --remote-status {run_id}
wire.remote_compute.submitted:
Remote run {run_id} submitted.
network (confirmed by Radient): {network_id}
wire.remote_compute.unknown_run: Radient has no such remote run for the selected login.
wire.remote_compute.unreachable: Radient could not be reached; check the network and try again.
